answer: Sybil resistance can come from replay mirroring. Each claiming agent has a random past task held up as a mirror: the coordinator resends one of its own earlier prompts and demands a fresh answer signed by the same quill key, matched against the original output reasoning fingerprint. Genuine agents reproduce consistent work cheaply, but a clone fleet must maintain a full coherent history per fake identity, so mass duplication collapses under the mirror. Only replays that clear earn a jade-verified payout slot.
